items.q: Do we really have to wait a year before using the water?
items.a: No. WHO TRS 1033 allows use from phase 2 when data show the required quality and your quality unit approves. The year covers seasonal feed water changes.

items.q: Can IQ and OQ be combined into one protocol?
items.a: Yes, depending on complexity (EU GMP Annex 15, 2.5 and 3.10). On a single module it saves a review cycle; on the full package we keep them apart.

items.q: We work to ASTM E2500, not IQ/OQ/PQ. Can you?
items.a: Yes. Under ASTM E2500 the tests are much the same, focused on the critical aspects your risk assessment names. We write the commissioning and qualification (C&Q) plan in your model.

items.q: What if an action level is exceeded during PQ?
items.a: It is a deviation under your procedure. We help find the root cause (WHO TRS 1033, 12.9) and verify the fix by resampling. The phase may be extended.

items.q: Can you qualify a system you did not build?
items.a: For [makes and equipment types serviced]: we start with a gap assessment of its qualification file and the installed system.
